label: For "Quality Escape Root-Cause Agent": When a defect reaches a customer or a late test, trace the affected lots through genealogy, line data and supplier records, rank likely causes and draft the containment and corrective action plan for the quality engineer. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Guessing the affected lots.
